mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY and HOUST increases by > 5% MoM, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5% and HOUST MoM growth > 5%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window for the specified interaction condition.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in post-shock recovery regimes, a 10% MoM increase in RSAFS signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of post-shock recovery instances with RSAFS MoM growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high FEDFUNDS (> 4%) indicates tightening monetary conditions, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a 0.5pp increase in UNRATE within 2 months signals labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with UNRATE increasing by > 0.5pp in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth is below 1% YoY and PAYEMS decreases by > 2% MoM, S&P 500 forward returns are negatively impacted over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth < 1% and PAYEMS MoM decline > 2%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window for the specified interaction condition.
